cards.title: Why it works
items: The teaching pair's other half: this file travels save -> library -> re-run, proving byte-portability of a real graph
The courier is a pure hand-off — no reasoning about the value — so the verifier tests the engine, not a model
The verifier may only prove the hand-off from what the engine hands it, never from memory
